finding.issue: TASK-134 requires grounded_query_planning.py itself to expose exactly two public names: GroundedQueryPlanningError and plan_grounded_retrieval_query. The candidate sets __all__ correctly, but it also binds additional non-underscore module names through `from __future__ import annotations`, `Iterable`, `TYPE_CHECKING`, `CanonicalRetrievalField`, and `retrieve_canonical_variant_profiles`. This repeats the exact public-module leakage class corrected in TASK-133. The module also imports CanonicalVariantProfile from canonical_profile under TYPE_CHECKING even though the TASK-134 import boundary permits only the two existing TASK-122 public retrieval APIs plus standard-library typing/collections support.
